seo__search_description: Oakdene House Foundation Accessibility Statement — our commitment to making our website and services accessible to everyone.
intro__text: Oakdene House Foundation is committed to making our website accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities.
our_commitment__text: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA standards across our website. We are continuously working to improve accessibility and welcome feedback from people who use assistive technologies.
what_we_ve_done__list: Semantic HTML throughout for better screen reader compatibility
Resizable text without loss of functionality
Labels and instructions on all form fields
known_limitations__text: We're honest about where we haven't got there yet:
known_limitations__list: Some older PDF resources may not be fully accessible. If you need an accessible version of any document, please [contact us](/contact/) and we'll provide one.
Third-party embedded forms (Jotform) and payment tools (Stripe) follow their own accessibility standards, which may differ slightly from ours.
Video content, if added in future, will include captions — please let us know if you find any without.
accessibility_at_our_centre__text: Our centre at 29 Vine Street, Fairfield has:
accessibility_at_our_centre__list: Step-free access to the main entrance
Accessible parking via the Fairfield RSL car park on the corner of Vine and Bertha Streets
Staff trained to support people with a range of accessibility needs
Interpreter services available on request — please let us know when you [contact us](/contact/)
accessibility_at_our_centre__text_2: If you have specific accessibility requirements for a visit or appointment, please [contact us](/contact/) ahead of time so we can make sure everything is in place.
need_our_help__text: If you have trouble accessing any part of our website or any of our services, please let us know. We're happy to provide information or support in the format that works best for you — large print, plain text, over the phone, or in person.
need_our_help__text_4: We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 2 business days.
reporting_an_issue__text: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on our website, please tell us:
reporting_an_issue__list: The page you were on (the URL is helpful)
What you were trying to do
The assistive technology or device you were using, if relevant
reporting_an_issue__text_2: We take accessibility seriously and will work to fix issues as quickly as we can.
